British jazz writer Peter Vacher was born on August 5, 1937. He played trombone as a youth, later directing his passion for jazz into the realm of writing. He has contributed to numerous jazz publications, including The Grove Encyclopedia of Jazz and Jazz Journal International. He co-authored Telling It Like It Is, with his longtime friend clarinetist Joe Darensbourg.
Peter was interviewed in Clearwater Beach, Florida on March 18, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
We are in Clearwater Beach. My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive and I’m really looking forward to talking to writer Peter Vacher.
And it’s going to be interesting to get a look at the lives of jazz musicians from someone who writes extensively about them, for what forty years now?
